Anjali Sinha
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra
anjali.sinha960@example.com | +91 9126465318

Dynamic talent acquisition professional with a focus on sourcing quality hires, improving hiring velocity, and enhancing candidate experience. Experienced in full-cycle recruitment, onboarding coordination, and leveraging LinkedIn Recruiter and ATS tools to build pipelines for technical and corporate roles. Not open to relocation; looking for roles in Navi Mumbai only. Notice period: 60 days.

Experience

Talent Acquisition Specialist (Hybrid)

- Collaborated with hiring managers in an Agile cadence to reduce time-to-fill from 50 to  Thirty-six days by prioritizing role families and scheduling focused interview blocks. (Agile, Talent Acquisition)
- Managed candidate touchpoints and Confluence-based hiring playbooks to standardize interview feedback cycles, improving hiring manager satisfaction scores by 22%. (Confluence, Recruitment)

Kite Learning — May 2021 - Mar 2024
HR Executive (Onsite)
- Owned end-to-end Recruitment for learning and operations roles, closing 75 hires over three years and reducing average hire time from 45 to 30 days through refined job descriptions and targeted sourcing. (Recruitment, Talent Acquisition)
- Ran Onboarding programs for new hires, implementing a structured 30-day onboarding checklist and Linux lab setup guides that cut onboarding issues by 40% and improved new-hire retention in the first 90 days. (Onboarding, Linux)
- Utilized LinkedIn Recruiter to build and nurture talent pools, achieved a 28% conversion from first contact to interview, and coordinated with teams using Confluence to document candidate assessments. (LinkedIn Recruiter, Confluence)

Projects
